title: docs(governance): objectui is a product-neutral renderer — AGENTS.md rule, ADR-0060, and a ratchet over registry keys, files and locale keys
body:
Fixes #12224
Clause-②: no

objectui is now a product-neutral renderer, as the maintainer ruled on 2026-10-12. This pull request writes the rule into `AGENTS.md`, records it as ADR-0060, and holds it with a ratchet test. `AGENTS.md` and `docs/adr/**` are governed (Tier H), so the whole pull request stays a **draft** until an authorized approval. Drafted in session `session_012dGTuJen61ECNHXYXKChoC`, branch `claude/issue-12224-product-neutral-renderer`.

The ruling, verbatim and untranslated:

> 现在转向

> 规则应该写入 objectui 仓库，要不然每个项目都会有页面定制的需求

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**

- objectui 从此是「产品中立的渲染器」。任何产品(Cloud、HotCRM、其他应用)都用 `@objectstack/spec` 的通用块拼自己的页面,文案留在产品自己的包里。页面拼不出来时,有两条路:在 objectui 加一个按「画什么」命名的**通用块**,或者在 `@objectstack/spec` 开一个**契约门**。不再为某个产品加专用的组件、对话框、hook 或文案命名空间。
- 规则写进 `AGENTS.md`(§1 新增一节,共 +10 行)和新的 ADR-0060。
- 新增一个「只减不增」的棘轮测试。今天已有的产品专用面都列在一张清单里:8 个注册名、28 个文件,以及 9 个冻结命名空间下的 90 个文案键(读于 `27c30c10`)。这张清单只能删,不能加。出现以下任何一种,测试都会变红:新的产品命名注册、冻结目录里的新文件、冻结命名空间下的新文案键。
- 新增 PR 模板,只有一个勾选项:Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string。

**为什么改**

- Cloud 控制台的页面一点点长进了 objectui。每改一句 Cloud 文案,就要一个 objectui PR 再加一次版本钉更新;有条车道曾为一个字符串(「团队版起」)等 Cloud。下一个接入的产品会重复这条路。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**

- 这是一道**新门禁**。它只读名字,也就是注册名、文件名和文案键名;起了中性名字的产品代码它看不见,只能靠评审和 PR 模板的勾选项。
- 为了让「只删不增」由机器守住,清单的**上限**写在 ADR-0060 末尾的 JSON 块里。往清单里加一项,就必须同时改 ADR;ADR 是受管文件,所以加项必须经过您批准。只往清单里追加,测试仍然是红的(见下方 M5)。
- 卡上说「locale 新增顶层命名空间即失败」。按字面读,连通用块需要的文案也加不进去,与规则 2 矛盾。本 PR 的读法是:名字以产品词(`cloud`、`hotcrm`)打头的命名空间或键,拒收;冻结命名空间下,不许加键;起中性名字的新命名空间,放行。详见下文「H3」。
- 冻结范围比卡上的清单多了几项,都是实测出来的:
  - `cloud-connection:panel` 这个注册;
  - `console/cloud-connection/` 和 `console/diagnostics/CloudAiModelStatus.tsx`;
  - `@object-ui/types` 的 `cloud.ts` 与 `zod/cloud.zod.ts`;
  - `planTier` 与 `aiModelStatus` 两个命名空间;
  - 整个 `environment` 命名空间(卡上只写了 `environment.entitlement`)。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 即可。它不碰任何运行时代码,也不发版(空 frontmatter changeset)。

**席位意见**

(留空,由席位定稿)

**你要做的**

- 这是一道新门禁,批准本 PR 即授权它:每次 `pnpm test` 都会在 `unit` 项目里跑它。
- 请确认以下几点:H3 的读法;冻结范围的增项;「清单上限写在 ADR 里,加项必须改 ADR」的做法。
- objectstack 侧那一行 rider 因行数棘轮零余量,本 PR 没有带上,待 PM 决定(见 Acceptance notes)。

## What changes

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | A "Product-neutral renderer" section in §1 (608 → 618 lines): the three rules, the escalation path, and where the ratchet and its two lists live. It cites no issue number. |
| `docs/adr/0060-product-neutral-renderer.md` | The ruling, the readings taken, the bounds, and the **Frozen baseline** JSON block that the test reads as its ceiling. 0060 was re-read on `origin/main` before opening and is still free; 0059 is the last ADR there. |
| `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` | The ratchet, 32 tests, in the root `unit` project. |
| `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-specific.allowlist.json` | The live list, edited only by deleting entries. |
| `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` | Two ledger rows: the ratchet reads ADR-0060, and `check-installed-spec-pin-claims` reads the new template. That gate scans every tracked file, and the ledger is pinned total over tracked markdown. |
| `.github/pull_request_template.md` | One checkbox, nothing else. It carries no closing keyword and no line address, so neither PR-body reader in this repository (`cross-repo-issue-closer.yml`, `check-changeset-claims.mjs`) finds anything in it. |
| `.changeset/12224-product-neutral-renderer.md` | Empty frontmatter: nothing is released, because `__tests__` is excluded from app-shell's build. |

## How the ratchet measures (ADR-0060 has the full text)

- **Registrations.** The ratchet takes every key from `deriveRegistryKeys` (`scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`), the one registration reader that `objectui check`'s known-type list already comes from. A key counts when any colon segment leads with a product word. It does not scan for `register('cloud:` itself.
- **Files.** A file counts when it is a non-test file under `packages/`, `apps/` or `examples/` and either sits in a frozen directory (`app-shell/src/environment/` or `app-shell/src/console/organizations/`, recursively) or has a path segment led by a product word.
- **Locale keys.** In every built-in locale, two kinds count: every leaf key under a frozen namespace, and every key at any depth whose own name leads with a product word.
- **Product words** are `cloud` and `hotcrm`, matched only when they lead the name at a word boundary, after skipping a hook's leading `use`. So `useCloudThing` counts, while `word-cloud` and `cloudy` do not.
- **Two lists.** The live list must equal the measurement exactly. An unlisted hit is red. A stale entry is red too, which makes the list shrink as pages migrate. Every live entry must also sit inside ADR-0060's ceiling, so appending to the live list alone stays red.

### H1: both registration spellings

At `923504f4a`, a literal `register('cloud:` grep finds two cloud widgets: `cloud:ai-model-status` and `cloud:onboarding-next`. `cloud:plan-status` and `cloud:workspace-timezone-notice` register as `register('plan-status', …, { namespace: 'cloud', skipFallback: true, … })` and similar, so a literal scan misses them. The derivation reads both spellings, and it found a fifth product registration that the card's inventory did not list: `cloud-connection:panel`, with `app-shell:` twins. The live list holds 8 keys. A fixture control in the test checks both spellings against a synthetic tree, so the namespace half is still tested after the last product widget has migrated. M1 and M2 below show the real tree going red on each spelling.

### H3: the locale rule's reading

Read literally, the card says two things: a new top-level namespace fails, and the list may only lose entries. Together they forbid every new namespace forever, including the generic-block copy that rule 2 asks for. The reading taken here follows rule 2's own words, "never an i18n namespace named for the product":

- a namespace, or a key at any depth, whose name leads with a product word fails, unless a frozen namespace holds it;
- under a frozen namespace, no key may be added in any locale;
- a new namespace with a neutral name passes.

ADR-0060 records this, and the 速读 above asks the maintainer to confirm it.

The frozen namespaces fall into three groups:

- **Led by a product word:** `cloudConnection`, `cloudOnboarding`, `cloudPlanStatus`, `cloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice`.
- **From the card's inventory:** `organizations`, `workspace`, and the whole of `environment`. Every source consumer of `environment` sits in the frozen `environment/` directory.
- **Measured:** `planTier` and `aiModelStatus`. Each has one consumer, and that consumer is a frozen or product-named file.

Some namespaces were considered and **not** frozen; the ADR gives the reasons:

- `organization` (singular), because `@object-ui/auth` and the layout also read it;
- `chatbotQuota`, a generic quota state;
- `marketplace` and `connectAgent`, features of the open stack.

The locale bundles are the ten in `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar. The test reads them through `@object-ui/i18n/locales`.

## Mutation proofs (acceptance 2)

All five proofs follow the same method:

- The implementation was committed first (`5298f952`).
- Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack's `scripts/`). It needs its anchor to hit exactly once and checks the write on disk, and its WRAP mode runs the test and then restores the file. The new-file leg (M3) was instead a bash script with a `trap` that removes the file.
- Every leg ends with `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status --porcelain` empty.
- Nothing was committed or pushed for any leg.
- Line addresses in the excerpts are elided, as AGENTS.md #11 asks.

Two first attempts did not count:

- M1 and M4 first used a replacement that still contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not drop.
- The tool refused both (`the anchor count moved 1 -> 1, a drop of 0`), and its restore proved the files unchanged.
- Both were re-run with a non-overlapping anchor. The runs below are those re-runs.

      Tests  1 failed | 31 passed (32)

```

The registration assertion now passes, because the key is listed. The ceiling assertion turns red instead.

      Tests  1 failed | 31 passed (32)

A change confined to `packages/plugin-map` or `packages/vscode-extension` still selects it, with the reason "reads the disk or spawns a process". A change to ADR-0060 alone selects it through the markdown ledger.

## Acceptance notes

- **What the ratchet cannot see.** ADR-0060 states each bound:
  - product code under a neutral name outside the frozen directories;
  - growth inside an existing file;
  - the derivation's own KNOWN GAP readings;
  - re-adding an entry that the live list already deleted, because the ceiling keeps it until an ADR amendment drops it.
- **Test files are outside the file half.** A test ships in no `dist`, and a regression test on frozen code has to stay writable until that code migrates. This is the H2 decision, and it is recorded in ADR-0060. `organizations/manage/` is inside the frozen directory, since the freeze is recursive.
- **H4 ledgers.** `scripts/__tests__/turbo-test-inputs.test.ts` guards the Vitest *configuration program*, not the files a test reads, so the ratchet needs no row there. It ran green above. `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` did need rows, both listed under "What changes".
- **H7.** objectui#7611 had not landed at `923504f4a`, the base, which still matched `origin/main` when this pull request was opened. The baseline is read at this pull request's head. If #7611 lands first with keys under a frozen namespace, the live list and ceiling are re-read at the new head before landing; no exemption is reserved for it.
- **The objectstack rider is not in a pull request yet.** The card asks for one line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md`. Measured on `objectstack@9f4b652e3`, that file is 58 lines against a `check-skill-line-ratchet` ceiling of 58, so its headroom is 0. The drafted line (`- UI 卡写明所需通用块或 spec 契约门;要产品命名 widget/dialog/hook/命名空间的卡退回重立。`, 116 bytes, green on `check:pm-skill-id-lint`) takes the file to 59. The ratchet then answers `✗ … filing-gate.md is 59 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 58`. The dispatch allowed one line and said to stop on a breach, so the rider waits for the PM to choose how the line is paid for. Its branch, `claude/issue-12224-objectui-filing-gate-rider`, is pushed with no commits.
